```{r}
## load libraries 
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
```
# 1. Purpose

This file examines missing doctor-visit outcomes in the original
1992–2003 dataset and audits the omission of positive-visit categories
from the 2000–2003 coding. It documents the correction separately
from the main 1992–1996 analysis.
```{r}
## read data 
df_raw <- read_sas("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lx-leong/ec4305_e2_g7/main/data/c9203.sas7bdat")
```

```{r}
names(df_raw) <- tolower(names(df_raw))

df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

stopifnot(
  nrow(df_raw) == 160821L,
  !anyNA(df_raw$year),
  all(df_raw$year %in% 1992:2003)
)
github_data <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "lx-leong/ec4305_e2_g7/main/data/"
)
zip_filename <- "NHIS_raw.zip"

zip_url <- paste0(
  github_data,
  URLencode(zip_filename, reserved = TRUE)
)

zip_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")

download.file(
  zip_url,
  zip_path,
  mode = "wb"
)

# Extract raw survey files into a temporary folder
extract_folder <- tempfile("nhis_raw_")
dir.create(extract_folder)

unzip(
  zip_path,
  exdir = extract_folder
)

raw_folder <- file.path(extract_folder, "NHIS_raw")

stopifnot(dir.exists(raw_folder))

output_folder <- file.path("output", "sawdr_audit")

dir.create(
  output_folder,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

```
# 2. Original doctor-visit missingness, 1992–2003
```{r}
survey_audit <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    sawdr_missing_n = sum(is.na(sawdr)),
    sawdr_missing_pct = 100 * mean(is.na(sawdr)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(survey_audit, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
p_original_missingness <- ggplot(
  survey_audit,
  aes(year, sawdr_missing_pct)
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1996.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1992:2003) +
  labs(
    title = "Doctor-visit missingness in the original dataset",
    x = "Survey year",
    y = "Missing doctor-visit outcome (%)",
    caption = paste(
      "Before correcting the 2000–2003 coding omission.",
      "Percentages are unweighted."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_original_missingness
```

# 3. Reconstructing the 2000–2003 coding
We reconstruct the original doctor-visit indicator from the raw files,
then include positive-visit categories 6–8 in the corrected indicator.
Unknown responses remain missing.
```{r}
# Starting positions of the two-character visit category
visit_positions <- c(
  "2000" = 703,
  "2001" = 763,
  "2002" = 742,
  "2003" = 725
)

find_dat <- function(survey_year, filename) {

  paths <- list.files(
    file.path(raw_folder, as.character(survey_year)),
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  matched <- paths[
    tolower(basename(paths)) == tolower(filename)
  ]

  if (length(matched) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Expected exactly one ", filename,
      " for ", survey_year,
      "; found ", length(matched)
    )
  }

  matched
}

# Read fields as text to preserve leading zeros in identifiers
read_fields <- function(path, positions) {

  starts <- vapply(positions, function(x) x[1], numeric(1))
  ends <- vapply(positions, function(x) x[2], numeric(1))
  column_order <- order(starts)

  result <- read_fwf(
    path,
    col_positions = fwf_positions(
      start = starts[column_order],
      end = ends[column_order],
      col_names = names(positions)[column_order]
    ),
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    trim_ws = TRUE,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(problems(result)) > 0) {
    stop("Parsing problems in: ", path)
  }

  result
}

```

```{r}
audit_year <- function(survey_year) {

  visit_start <- unname(
    visit_positions[as.character(survey_year)]
  )

  person <- read_fields(
    find_dat(survey_year, "PERSONSX.DAT"),
    list(
      record_type = c(1, 2),
      year = c(3, 6),
      hhx = c(7, 12),
      fmx = c(13, 14),
      px = c(15, 16),
      intv_qrt = c(17, 17),
      sex = c(18, 18),
      age = c(19, 20),
      dob_m = c(23, 24),
      dob_y = c(25, 28)
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(year, intv_qrt, sex, age, dob_m, dob_y),
        ~ as.numeric(.x)
      )
    )

  adult <- read_fields(
    find_dat(survey_year, "SAMADULT.DAT"),
    list(
      record_type = c(1, 2),
      year = c(3, 6),
      hhx = c(7, 12),
      fmx = c(13, 14),
      px = c(15, 16),
      ahcnoyr2 = c(visit_start, visit_start + 1)
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(year, ahcnoyr2), ~ as.numeric(.x))
    )

  keys <- c("year", "hhx", "fmx", "px")
  stopifnot(
    all(person$year == survey_year),
    all(adult$year == survey_year),
    all(person$record_type == "20"),
    all(adult$record_type == "30"),
    !anyNA(person[keys]),
    !anyNA(adult[keys]),
    !anyDuplicated(person[keys]),
    !anyDuplicated(adult[keys]),
    all(
      is.na(adult$ahcnoyr2) |
        adult$ahcnoyr2 %in% c(0:8, 97:99)
    ),
    nrow(anti_join(adult, person, by = keys)) == 0
  )

  adult <- adult %>%
    select(-record_type) %>%
    mutate(sample_adult_linked = TRUE)

  person %>%
    left_join(adult, by = keys) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_adult_linked = replace_na(
        sample_adult_linked, FALSE
      ),

      birth_month = if_else(
        dob_m %in% 1:12, dob_m, NA_real_
      ),

      birth_year = if_else(
        dob_y <= year, dob_y, NA_real_
      ),

      birth_quarter = ceiling(birth_month / 3),

      age4 = (
        4 * (year - birth_year) +
          intv_qrt - birth_quarter
      ) / 4,

      female = sex - 1,

      # Reproduce the supplied construction
      sawdr_original = case_when(
        ahcnoyr2 == 0 ~ 0,
        ahcnoyr2 %in% 1:5 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # Restore all observed positive-visit categories
      sawdr_corrected = case_when(
        ahcnoyr2 == 0 ~ 0,
        ahcnoyr2 %in% 1:8 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      sawdr_recovered = as.integer(
        ahcnoyr2 %in% 6:8
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      between(age, 50, 75),
      age4 > 55,
      age4 < 75
    )
}

# Audit data only
later_audit <- bind_rows(
  lapply(2000:2003, audit_year)
)
``` 
# 4. Validating the reconstruction

The processed dataset does not retain the original person identifiers.
Therefore, we compare joint distributions of year, age, quarter-year
age, sex and the original doctor-visit indicator. This is not an
individual-level record match.
``` {r}
# Check that the original construction reproduces the joint
# distribution of these variables in the supplied extract.
# This is a distribution check, not an ID-level comparison,
# because the processed extract does not retain the original IDs.
validation_vars <- c(
  "year", "age", "age4", "female", "sawdr"
)

rebuilt_counts <- later_audit %>%
  mutate(sawdr = sawdr_original) %>%
  count(
    across(all_of(validation_vars)),
    name = "n_rebuilt"
  )

reference_counts <- df_raw %>%
  filter(between(year, 2000, 2003)) %>%
  count(
    across(all_of(validation_vars)),
    name = "n_reference"
  )

validation <- full_join(
  rebuilt_counts,
  reference_counts,
  by = validation_vars
) %>%
  mutate(
    n_rebuilt = replace_na(n_rebuilt, 0L),
    n_reference = replace_na(n_reference, 0L)
  )

stopifnot(
  all(validation$n_rebuilt == validation$n_reference)
)

```


# 5. Correction results

These are unweighted counts. Remaining missing outcomes are separated
into respondents without a linked Sample Adult record and respondents
with a linked record but an unknown visit response.
```{r}

# Show the number of responses restored
correction_audit <- later_audit %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_persons = n(),
    missing_before = sum(is.na(sawdr_original)),
    responses_recovered = sum(sawdr_recovered),
    missing_after = sum(is.na(sawdr_corrected)),
    missing_pct_before = 100 * mean(is.na(sawdr_original)),
    missing_pct_after = 100 * mean(is.na(sawdr_corrected)),
    no_sample_adult_record = sum(!sample_adult_linked),
    linked_but_missing_response = sum(
      sample_adult_linked & is.na(sawdr_corrected)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Verify that the missingness accounting adds up
stopifnot(
  all(
    correction_audit$missing_before -
      correction_audit$responses_recovered ==
      correction_audit$missing_after
  ),
  all(
    correction_audit$no_sample_adult_record +
      correction_audit$linked_but_missing_response ==
      correction_audit$missing_after
  )
)

print(correction_audit, n = Inf, width = Inf)

knitr::kable(
  correction_audit %>%
    select(
      year, n_persons, missing_before,
      responses_recovered, missing_after
    ),
  caption = "Doctor-visit coding correction, 2000–2003"
)

cat(
  "Total positive-visit responses restored:",
  sum(correction_audit$responses_recovered),
  "\n"
)
```


# 6. Implications for the main analysis

Including categories 6–8 restores positive doctor-visit responses that
were missing under the original coding. It does not recover responses
for respondents without linked Sample Adult data or with unknown
visit responses.

The correction does not resolve the changes in survey collection or
the later-period weighting question. Our main analysis therefore uses
1992–1996, while this file documents the later-period coding issue
separately. The audit does not modify the main cleaned dataset.

  row.names = FALSE
)
